> If $\omega_k(n)$ counts the number of distinct prime factors of $n$ which are $>k$, then is it true that, for every $k\geq 1$, $$\liminf_{n\to \infty}\sum_{0\leq i < k}\omega_k(n+i)\leq k?$$
